canvas_settings.image_style: clean modern high-fidelity web app UI mockup, flat design, sans-serif typography, light theme

layers.description: Solid light grey page backdrop filling the entire square canvas behind everything else.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Root background layer; the browser window floats centered on top of it.

layers.description: A desktop browser window with rounded corners and a soft drop shadow, white content area, occupying most of the canvas; its chrome strip along the window top shows three small grey circular window buttons at the left and a wide rounded grey address bar.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Centered above the background; the app card sits inside its white content area below the chrome strip.

layers.description: App header band across the top of the white content area: on the left the bold dark heading "Kanban board"; to its right a rounded dropdown select showing the dark label "All users" with a small grey chevron; on the far right a rounded text input with grey placeholder text "Add a card…" followed by a blue rounded button with white label "Add".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Inside the browser window content area, above the three board columns.

layers.description: A single rounded light column panel with a thin border titled by the bold heading "To Do" at its top, holding two plain white card rows and one expanded edit band, separated by thin dividers. The first card row shows the dark title "Write weekly report", beside it a small rounded light-blue pill chip with the dark label "Ada", and at the right edge two small grey action labels "Edit" and "Delete". The second row is an expanded inline edit band for the card "Fix login redirect": a text input prefilled with "Fix login redirect", beside it a rounded dropdown select showing the label "Grace" with a small grey chevron, and a blue rounded button with white label "Save"; no Edit or Delete labels on this band. The third card row shows the dark title "Buy milk" with no chip and at the right edge the two small grey action labels "Edit" and "Delete".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Leftmost of three equal board columns arranged side by side with equal gaps; rows are drawn strictly inside this panel.

layers.description: A single rounded light column panel with a thin border titled by the bold heading "In Progress" at its top, holding two plain white card rows separated by a thin divider; each row shows its dark title at the left, beside it a small rounded light-blue pill chip, and at the right edge two small grey action labels "Edit" and "Delete". First row: title "Refactor board module" with chip "Linus". Second row: title "Draft ADR-004" with chip "Barbara".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Middle of the three equal board columns, between "To Do" on the left and "Done" on the right; rows are drawn strictly inside this panel.

layers.description: A single rounded light column panel with a thin border titled by the bold heading "Done" at its top, holding two card rows separated by a thin divider; each row shows a small green circular check icon at the left, then muted grey title text, then a small rounded light-blue pill chip, and at the right edge only one small grey action label "Delete" — no Edit label, no checkbox anywhere. First row: muted title "Migrate todo list" with chip "Alan". Second row: muted title "Set up CI" with no chip.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Rightmost of the three equal board columns; rows are drawn strictly inside this panel.
